# oncallalert_schedule (Data Source)

Looks up a schedule by exact name (case-insensitive).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oncallalert_schedule" "ops" {
  name = "Ops"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
